cases.name: Close-return differs from intrabar touch
cases.mechanism: The return anchor is the earlier formation open and source return requires abs(close-anchor)<0.0001 after a hit flag.
minimal_event_sequence: Completed 06–09 formation open=100; 09–12 tracking open=102; upper target=105.
A completed tracking bar O=102 H=106 L=99 C=101 hits target and crosses100.
Next completed bar O=101 H=102 L=99 C=100.
hand_reasoned_expected_behavior: First bar: touch/cross of100=true, source close_return=false. Second bar: source close_return=true.
Use100, not tracking open102, as return anchor. Publish each predicate no earlier than supporting bar availability; neither proves a fill.
cases.suggested_scope: Shared-bar anchors, distinct predicate definitions, close availability; source-specific counters remain downstream.

cases.name: Week identity replaces previous-bar weekday reset
cases.mechanism: Source reset requires Monday stats start and preceding bar not Monday, which fails on a continuous Monday chart.
minimal_event_sequence: Friday leaves completed-session count=3.
Monday 08:59 bar followed by Monday09:00 statistics-window start.
hand_reasoned_expected_behavior: Source literal condition does not reset because prior bar is Monday.
A proposed corrected weekly accumulator resets once on new explicit week identity; repeated09:00 delivery does not reset twice. Preserve source discrepancy/version, not silent equivalence.
cases.suggested_scope: Shared calendar/window identity plus downstream correction proposal; no weekly-stat implementation requested here.

cases.name: Provisional hit cannot enter completed denominator
cases.mechanism: Hits update during the active session, denominator at its observed end; medians include successful hits only.
minimal_event_sequence: One completed eligible session: one hit at10minutes.
Second session reaches target at5minutes but remains open.
Second session subsequently closes normally; third completes with no hit.
hand_reasoned_expected_behavior: While second open, completed frequency stays1/1 with separate provisional hit; literal source counter can show2/1=200%.
After second completion:2/2. After third:2/3; hit-time median over [10,5] is7.5minutes conditional on hit, not over all three.
No completed eligible observations means unavailable denominator, not an observed0% rate.
cases.suggested_scope: Completion and eligibility metadata feeding downstream estimators.

cases.name: Both London edges do not prove sequence
cases.mechanism: The source Sequential H+L quantity is conjunction of high/low coverage without chronology.
minimal_event_sequence: Completed London range L=90 H=110.
NY provides one completed bar O=100 H=111 L=89 C=101, without finer events.
hand_reasoned_expected_behavior: High_taken=true and low_taken=true, both_coverage=true. High_first/low_first remains unknown.
Two possible within-bar paths through111 then89 or89 then111 yield identical OHLC; a requested ordered event must remain unresolved.
cases.suggested_scope: Direct shared-bar OHLC information boundary and downstream both-touch naming.

cases.name: Close-reclaim rate retains joint cohort denominator
cases.mechanism: Source wick-and-close outcome divides by all bullish/bearish London sessions in the regime, not just sessions that wick.
minimal_event_sequence: Four completed bullish London sessions in one regime, body25=100 each.
Only sessions1 and2 have NY low<100; session1 closes101, session2 closes99; sessions3 and4 never wick.
hand_reasoned_expected_behavior: Joint wick-and-reclaim frequency=1/4; conditional reclaim given wick=1/2. Store both names and denominators if both are offered.
Equality NYlow=100 does not meet strict wick predicate. Retain all cohort records without claiming independent source confirmations.
cases.suggested_scope: Shared-bar strict inequalities and cohort metadata; downstream empirical estimation.

cases.name: Eviction uses original admitted contribution
cases.mechanism: Source subtracts evicted close exceedance using a recomputed mean rather than the mean used when admitting it.
minimal_event_sequence: Construct an admitted observation A with close-minus-open=5, assigned threshold4, contribution=true.
Before eviction, changed retained-window data produce current threshold6.
Evict A.
hand_reasoned_expected_behavior: Under fixed-at-admission semantics, decrement its saved true contribution exactly once even though5>6 is false.
Alternatively recompute every retained predicate under one current threshold and label that different estimand. A mix of old admissions/new removals is invalid; clipping cannot repair it.
cases.suggested_scope: Downstream reducer proposal requiring retained threshold/version/contribution, not a claim that shared bars estimate Statmap.

cases.name: Raid minimum is not displayed first bucket threshold
cases.mechanism: Strict raid minimum5 and coarse bucket0<30 do not justify a displayed >=20 count.
minimal_event_sequence: Formation H=100; min_raid=5; later completed bar H=106 C=100 confirms overshoot6.
Separate cases overshoot=5,20,75,80 mature at the configured cutoff.
hand_reasoned_expected_behavior: Overshoot6 qualifies as raid but does not satisfy >=20; exact5 fails strict >5 qualification;20 satisfies >=20.
Source bucket0 includes6 and20. Numerical overflow starts80, so75 must not be equated with overflow despite >70 display label.
Retain raw maximum excursion, point units, strictness and numeric boundaries independently of bucket labels.
cases.suggested_scope: Shared-bar excursions/equality and downstream bucket semantics.

cases.name: Raid zero cutoff and capped history are explicit policies
cases.mechanism: Source cutoff0 never expires and max_days accepts first N matured observations rather than a rolling N.
minimal_event_sequence: Set max_days=2 and positive cutoff. Complete three eligible range sessions A,B,C.
In separate definition set cutoff=0, observe a qualified raid and then next range start.
hand_reasoned_expected_behavior: Literal source population retains A,B; a rolling variant would retain B,C and must carry another definition.
Under literal zero-cutoff behavior no expiry tally is inferred. A corrected next-window/session-end maturity policy must be explicit before obtaining a completed observation.
cases.suggested_scope: Outcome horizon and retention definition metadata, not native market validation.

cases.name: Display visibility cannot change numeric formation
cases.mechanism: Both sources couple extrema state to chart boxes although completion reads numeric box values.
minimal_event_sequence: Replay identical completed formation bars with highs[102,105], lows[99,98], opens/closes retained.
Evaluate definition twice, display_box=true and false, with all numeric settings identical.
hand_reasoned_expected_behavior: A proposed corrected shared numeric aggregate returns H=105 L=98 range7 in both runs, same lineage and availability.
Literal source visibility dependency is recorded as discrepancy. Rendering identity may differ; numeric definition must not depend on it.
cases.suggested_scope: Direct shared-bar calculation/render separation; no source Pine execution performed.

cases.name: Body envelope is not aggregate candle body
cases.mechanism: Body basis uses all constituent open/close endpoints, so OHLC reaggregation loses required body-envelope information.
minimal_event_sequence: Aggregate these bars into one session candle O=100 H=112 L=99 C=100.
hand_reasoned_expected_behavior: Constituent body envelope=[100,110], width10; session candle body width0; wick range13.
An aggregate candle alone does not prove the constituent body envelope. Preserve sufficient body extrema or return unsupported for this derived feature after lossy aggregation.
cases.suggested_scope: Direct shared-bar sufficient statistics and definition-aware aggregation.
